move: avatar with spinning gradient ring, LIVE badge heartbeats, pulse rings out, viewer count ticks
how: A dark frame with a red radial glow, a 420px avatar wrapped in a conic-gradient ring (rotating 0->360 linearly over the full 4s), three pulse ring divs, a slow Ken Burns on the avatar photo, a red LIVE pill with a white dot, a name block and a viewers pill with a rolling number. 0-20%: the avatar scales .6->1 and fades with back.out(1.5); name and viewers rise 30px with expo.out at 7% and 11%; at 12% the LIVE pill pops from 0 with back.out(3). Heartbeats at 25%, 50%, 75%: the pill scales 1.16 (power2.out, 0.14s) then settles with elastic.out(1,.4), the glow swells 1.15, and a pulse ring expands .9->1.55 fading (power2.out, 1.1s). The white dot blinks yoyo 16 times. The count rolls out (yPercent -100) and back in with back.out(1.5) at 32%, 57% and 82%, ending on its start value.
adapt: Change the name, handle, count values, the red (#ff2d55) accent and gradient stops, and the avatar photo. Keep the one-second heartbeat cadence, the 0.14s + elastic settle, and the 1.1s ring expansion.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the avatar, ring, pulses, pill and text inside el; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with heartbeats at 0.25D, 0.5D, 0.75D and count ticks at 0.32D/0.57D/0.82D. Scope '#v' and all selectors to el; the fromTo tweens already set immediateRender:false but the from() entrances need it when nested; loads assets/backgrounds/sunset.png by relative url.
caveats: ring rotation ends at 360 (visually equal to 0) and the count returns, but the entrance from() tweens do not reverse so the loop cuts on the entrance
from() tweens need immediateRender:false when nested
